title: Tech View starts with List's default columns, saved choices are kept
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on the Work Orders build under test with Work Orders view permission; the Board View and Tech View display options are on.
  2. The current location has at least 3 lead technicians shown as groups/columns (a technician is eligible when they are Clockable, Active, and their role is not Office or Time Clock User).
  3. Via New Work Order, create several work orders and set a Lead Technician on each, spread across the technicians with some left Unassigned; then open the Work Orders page.
  4. A brand-new user (no saved column preference) and, separately, a user with a saved List/Tech selection.
custom_steps:
1. As the new user, open Tech View and confirm the columns match the current production List default columns.
  2. As the user with a saved selection, confirm their saved columns are retained.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • With no saved column preference, Tech View uses the current production List default columns.
  • Existing saved List/Tech View column selections are kept.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options). Story reference: SV-10048 — Choose what is shown (fields and columns). Spec: Confluence page 845185030 “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options”, PRD v33 (2026-09-28), requirement(s) S5-R4, S5-R12 (read 30 Sep 2026). Review decisions/answers: Confluence page 853901313 where cited. Source-verified on 30 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S5-R4: “Until the user changes Tech View’s columns, Tech View shows the current production List default columns.”
  • S5-R12: “Existing saved List column selections stay exactly as they are.”
